scope: FLAG_SHADOW model shadows: caster selection, light-direction shadow tiles and world receivers; no game or renderer code imported

retail_evidence.purpose: High detail sets MaxModelShadows 1, ShadowZRange 17 and ShadowLodOffset 100.
Strings only: MaxModelShadows, ShadowZRange, ShadowLodOffset, ShadowLight.

references.purpose: FLAG_SHADOW (does this model cast shadows) and FLAG_REALLYCLOSE (view models).
Players set FLAG_SHADOW and clear it while stealthed or invisible.
Destructible models set FLAG_SHADOW and clear it for small models whose shadow shows through.
Legacy (uncompiled) projected shadow setup with a straight-down light direction and a frustum around the model.
Later-generation silhouette render-to-texture projected onto world geometry along the strongest shadow-casting light, with distance fade and really-close exclusion.

adaptations: Caster heights in an R32_FLOAT tile atlas are evaluated by the world fragment shaders instead of re-drawing receiving polygons.
Light direction from the strongest static source with a 40-degree minimum elevation, 60% strength, 96-unit fade, 2x2 coverage, 16 nearest visible casters within 2048 units are replacement policies.
ShadowZRange and ShadowLodOffset values are recorded but not interpreted.
